headline: Proposed new City Council Rules 61, 62, and 63, plus requests to change meeting start times and special meeting rules.
summary: A city manager's report on proposed Rules 61, 62, and 63 is on the agenda. Requests also ask for reviews of Rule Five, Rule 35, and public participation times.
items: Virtual attendee call-in information and a warning about a scam involving fake city officials
City Manager's informational report on proposed new Rules 61, 62, and 63 of the City Council rules
Request to review public participation rules and whether Council meetings should start at 5:30 or 6 p.m.
Request to review Rule Five on calling special Council meetings
Request to review Rule 35, "First Consideration of Orders Filed by Councilors," and decide whether to enforce or remove it
location: Esther Howland (South) Chamber, City Hall - 455 Main Street, Worcester, Massachusetts

. Virtual Attendee Call-In Information/Important Notice to Residents 1 
Pursuant to Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021 and in order to ensure active, public 
engagement, the City of Worcester currently allows for both in -person and remote 
participation at all City Council and Standing Committee meetings. To partake in the 
meeting, you may attend the meeting in -person within the meeting location, follow the 
below link to join via Zoom or dial the direct line as indicated. If you join a Zoom 
meeting by dialing in with a phone number, you can raise your hand by dialing *9.
Municipal and Legislative Operations Committee Zoom Link : 
https://worcesterma.zoomgov.com/j/1614999501
Municipal and Legislative Operations Committee Zoom Phone Number: +1 646 828 
7666

a.
Important Notice: Residents are advised of an ongoing scam involving the impersonation 
of city officials and departments. Scammers are fraudulently requesting payments be 
made for planning and zoning permits, as well as City Council petitions. All official 
emails regarding your petition will come exclusively from an @worcesterma.gov email 
address (such as clerk @worcesterma.gov), or via physical mail on the City of 
Worcester’s official letterhead. Any legitimate hearing letter will always include your 
specific application details, along with the scheduled hearing date, time, and location . 
The City of Worcester will never request payments via wire transfer.

. Miscellaneous Items 4 
Order of Councilor Jose A. Rivera - Request Standing Committee on Municipal and 
Legislative Operations review the Rules of the City Council relative to public 
participation to discuss the feasibility of amending the Rules of City Council to have all 
City Council meetings begin at either 5:30 p.m. or 6 p.m., with public participation 
occurring from the set time of either 5:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. or 6 p.m. to 7 p.m. each 
meeting.
# 11b CC October 13, 2026
a.
Order of Councilor Khrystian E. King – Request Standing Committee on Municipal and 
Legislative Operations review Rule Five (5) of the Rules of City Council, which allows 
for the mayor, or if the mayor is unable to serve, the vice chair of the city council, or any 
five (5) members thereof, to call a special meeting by causing written notices stating the 
time and purpose of holding such meetings, in an effort to determine any potential 
amendments to the rule that would better assist City Council in completing its regular 
business.
